title: Hedgehog wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='24' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- lighter belly / face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#D2A067'/>
  <!-- spines -->
  <g fill='#5C3A1E'>
    <polygon points='20,58 14,44 26,50'/>
    <polygon points='28,48 24,34 36,44'/>
    <polygon points='38,44 38,30 48,40'/>
    <polygon points='50,42 52,28 60,40'/>
    <polygon points='62,44 68,32 72,46'/>
    <polygon points='72,50 80,42 80,56'/>
    <polygon points='78,60 88,58 82,68'/>
    <polygon points='20,68 10,66 20,76'/>
    <polygon points='26,78 16,82 28,86'/>
  </g>
  <!-- spines highlights -->
  <g fill='#A0714A'>
    <polygon points='22,56 18,48 26,52'/>
    <polygon points='40,42 40,34 46,40'/>
    <polygon points='64,42 68,36 70,46'/>
    <polygon points='74,54 78,48 78,58'/>
  </g>
  <!-- face / snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#E8C08A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='68' r='3' fill='#2B1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='3' fill='#2B1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='67' r='1' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='67' r='1' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#3A2413'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='75' r='1' fill='#8A6A4A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 81 Q50 86 56 81' stroke='#5C3A1E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,32 36,58 64,58' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='44,46 48,58 52,58 48,43' fill='#FF5D8F'/>
  <polygon points='52,40 56,50 60,58 56,58 52,47' fill='#4CC9F0'/>
  <!-- hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='5' fill='#FF5D8F'/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x='34' y='56' width='32' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#4CC9F0'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='91' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='91' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='91' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#D2A067'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='91' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#D2A067'/>
</svg>
